replaces.change: The bundled sesame chicken salad poached chicken for 8 minutes with no doneness check, dressed it with 50 g soy sauce, and called for 440 g green onions while hiding the carrot and soya beans in the instructions. This version poaches to a 165°F thermometer check, cuts soy to 1 tbsp lifted by lime and honey, uses a realistic handful of green onions, and puts the edamame, carrot and tomato properly on the line. Black-bean line dropped - edamame covers the bean role; noted here since the bundled file mixed the two.

qty.note: the bundled 50 g soy line, cut to 1 tbsp and balanced with lime

steps.text: Lay the chicken in a pan just wide enough to hold it, add water to cover by a thumb's width with the grated ginger, and bring to the barest simmer over medium heat - bubbles should barely break the surface.

Poach gently for 12 minutes, lid on, then check the thickest piece with a thermometer: it must read 165°F (74°C), the FSIS safe minimum for poultry. If short, slide the pan back on the heat for a few minutes.

safety.source: USDA FSIS safe minimum internal temperature table

steps.text: Lift the chicken out to rest on a plate and pour off the poaching water - it carries no flavour worth keeping. Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, juice of half the lime, honey and sesame oil into a dressing; taste - it should land sour first, then sweet, then salty.
Shred the rested chicken along the grain with two forks so it pulls into soft ribbons rather than crumbling.
Toss the romaine, grated carrot, tomatoes, green onions, chicken and edamame in a wide bowl just before eating - dressed early, the lettuce goes limp.
Dress the salad and divide it between bowls, finishing with the toasted sesame seeds and the remaining lime cut into wedges.

nutrition_per_serving.basis: USDA FoodData Central values committed in apps/ios/Resources/usda_ingredient_catalog.sqlite (matched fdc_id per ingredient in tables/nutrition-map.json), plus the app's shipped core-ingredient table (data.json) for items without an fdc_id; scaled by evidenced gram quantities
